mapper.select: SELECT provider, enabled, updated_at, updated_by FROM guest_login_policy ORDER BY provider
mapper.update: INSERT INTO guest_login_policy (provider, enabled, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{provider}, #{enabled}, #{updatedBy}, #{at}) ON CONFLICT (provider) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
